records.question: ۲۰ حساب اول را به ترتیب صعودی شناسه حساب، به همراه شناسه حساب، عنوان انگلیسی آن‌ها و عنوان انگلیسی عنصر مرتبط نمایش دهید.
records.reference_sql: SELECT TOP (20) a.[AccountId], a.[Title_En], e.[Title_En] AS ElementTitleEn FROM [ACC].[Account] AS a INNER JOIN [PAY].[Element] AS e ON e.[AccountRef] = a.[AccountId] ORDER BY a.[AccountId]

records.question: List the first 20 accounts ordered by account ID ascending, together with their account IDs, English titles and the English title of the related element.
records.reference_sql: SELECT TOP (20) a.[AccountId], a.[Title_En], e.[Title_En] AS ElementTitleEn FROM [ACC].[Account] AS a INNER JOIN [PAY].[Element] AS e ON e.[AccountRef] = a.[AccountId] ORDER BY a.[AccountId]

records.question: لیست کن اولین 20 کد حساب به همراه عنوان انگلیسی آن‌ها و عنوان انگلیسی هر عنصر مرتبط بر اساس کد
records.reference_sql: SELECT TOP (20) a.[Code], a.[Title_En], e.[Title_En] AS ElementTitle FROM [ACC].[Account] AS a JOIN [PAY].[Element] AS e ON e.[AccountRef] = a.[AccountId] ORDER BY a.[Code]

records.question: List the first 20 account records ordered by account code ascending. Return the account code, its English title, and the English title of the associated element. Include accounts that have no associated element; for those accounts, the element title may be empty.
records.reference_sql: SELECT TOP (20) a.[Code], a.[Title_En], e.[Title_En] AS ElementTitle FROM [ACC].[Account] AS a LEFT JOIN [PAY].[Element] AS e ON e.[AccountRef] = a.[AccountId] ORDER BY a.[Code]

records.question: تعداد حساب‌ها برای هر نوع تراز و وضعیت فعال بودن چه مقدار است؟ بر اساس تراز و وضعیت فعال بودن
records.reference_sql: SELECT [BalanceType], [IsActive], COUNT(*) AS AccountCount FROM [ACC].[Account] GROUP BY [BalanceType], [IsActive] ORDER BY [BalanceType], [IsActive]

records.question: What is the count of accounts for each BalanceType and activation status? Ordered by BalanceType and activation status.
records.reference_sql: SELECT [BalanceType], [IsActive], COUNT(*) AS AccountCount FROM [ACC].[Account] GROUP BY [BalanceType], [IsActive] ORDER BY [BalanceType], [IsActive]

records.question: مجموع مبلغ اسناد برای هر سال و ماه چقدر است؟
records.reference_sql: SELECT [Year], [Month], SUM([Amount]) AS TotalAmount FROM [ACC].[AccVchHdr] GROUP BY [Year], [Month]

records.question: What is the total voucher amount for each year and month?
records.reference_sql: SELECT [Year], [Month], SUM([Amount]) AS TotalAmount FROM [ACC].[AccVchHdr] GROUP BY [Year], [Month]

records.question: ۲۰ دارایی با بیشترین مجموع هزینه خرید را به ترتیب نزولی مجموع هزینه نمایش دهید. شماره پلاک، عنوان و مجموع هزینه خرید را برگردانید. دارایی‌های بدون آیتم رسید خرید را نیز نگه دارید؛ مجموع هزینه آن‌ها می‌تواند خالی باشد.
records.reference_sql: SELECT TOP (20) a.[PlaqueNumber], a.[Title], SUM(ari.[TotalCost]) AS [TotalAcquisitionCost] FROM [AST].[Asset] a LEFT JOIN [AST].[AcquisitionReceiptItem] ari ON ari.[AssetRef] = a.[AssetId] GROUP BY a.[PlaqueNumber], a.[Title] ORDER BY [TotalAcquisitionCost] DESC

records.question: What are the plaque numbers, titles, and total acquisition costs of the first 20 assets ordered by total cost descending?
records.reference_sql: SELECT TOP (20) a.[PlaqueNumber], a.[Title], SUM(ari.[TotalCost]) AS [TotalAcquisitionCost] FROM [AST].[Asset] a LEFT JOIN [AST].[AcquisitionReceiptItem] ari ON ari.[AssetRef] = a.[AssetId] GROUP BY a.[PlaqueNumber], a.[Title] ORDER BY [TotalAcquisitionCost] DESC

records.question: کد، عنوان انگلیسی و تعداد گروه‌های دارایی هر کلاس دارایی را به ترتیب نزولی تعداد گروه‌ها نمایش دهید. کلاس‌های دارایی بدون گروه را نیز نمایش دهید و تعداد گروه آن‌ها را صفر در نظر بگیرید.
records.reference_sql: SELECT ac.[Code], ac.[Title_En], COUNT(ag.[AssetGroupID]) AS GroupCount FROM [AST].[AssetClass] AS ac LEFT JOIN [AST].[AssetGroup] AS ag ON ag.[AssetClassRef] = ac.[AssetClassID] GROUP BY ac.[Code], ac.[Title_En] ORDER BY GroupCount DESC

records.question: What are the codes and English titles of asset classes and how many asset groups belong to each, ordered by the number of groups descending?
records.reference_sql: SELECT ac.[Code], ac.[Title_En], COUNT(ag.[AssetGroupID]) AS GroupCount FROM [AST].[AssetClass] AS ac LEFT JOIN [AST].[AssetGroup] AS ag ON ag.[AssetClassRef] = ac.[AssetClassID] GROUP BY ac.[Code], ac.[Title_En] ORDER BY GroupCount DESC

records.question: What are the top 20 assets with their plaque numbers and titles, along with the date of their most recent transaction, ordered by the latest transaction date descending?
records.reference_sql: SELECT TOP (20)     a.[PlaqueNumber],     a.[Title],     MAX(at.[ActivityDate]) AS [LastTransactionDate] FROM [AST].[Asset] AS a JOIN [AST].[AssetTransaction] AS at ON at.[AssetRef] = a.[AssetId] GROUP BY a.[PlaqueNumber], a.[Title] ORDER BY [LastTransactionDate] DESC

records.question: چند کلاس دارایی در هر سال ایجاد شده‌اند؟
records.reference_sql: SELECT YEAR([CreationDate]) AS [Year], COUNT(*) AS [ClassCount] FROM [AST].[AssetClass] GROUP BY YEAR([CreationDate])

records.question: How many asset classes were created each year?
records.reference_sql: SELECT YEAR([CreationDate]) AS [Year], COUNT(*) AS [ClassCount] FROM [AST].[AssetClass] GROUP BY YEAR([CreationDate])

records.question: تعداد دارایی‌ها برای هر وضعیت را نمایش دهید.
records.reference_sql: SELECT [State], COUNT(*) AS [AssetCount] FROM [AST].[Asset] GROUP BY [State]

records.question: Show the number of assets for each state.
records.reference_sql: SELECT [State], COUNT(*) AS [AssetCount] FROM [AST].[Asset] GROUP BY [State]

records.question: ۲۰ شعبه بانک اول را به ترتیب صعودی شناسه شعبه، به همراه شناسه شعبه، کد، عنوان و نام بانک مربوطه نمایش دهید.
records.reference_sql: SELECT TOP (20) bb.[BankBranchId], bb.[Code], bb.[Title] AS BranchTitle, b.[Title] AS BankTitle FROM [RPA].[BankBranch] AS bb INNER JOIN [RPA].[Bank] AS b ON bb.[BankRef] = b.[BankId] ORDER BY bb.[BankBranchId]

records.question: Show the first 20 bank branches ordered by branch ID ascending, with their branch ID, code, title, and the name of their bank.
records.reference_sql: SELECT TOP (20) bb.[BankBranchId], bb.[Code], bb.[Title] AS BranchTitle, b.[Title] AS BankTitle FROM [RPA].[BankBranch] AS bb INNER JOIN [RPA].[Bank] AS b ON bb.[BankRef] = b.[BankId] ORDER BY bb.[BankBranchId]

records.question: برای هر شعبه بانک، تعداد حساب‌های مرتبط را به همراه عنوان شعبه نمایش دهید و 20 شعبه با بیشترین حساب را نشان دهید به ترتیب  نزولی تعداد حساب.
records.reference_sql: SELECT TOP (20)  b.[Title], COUNT(a.[BankAccountId]) AS AccountCount FROM [RPA].[BankBranch] AS b LEFT JOIN [RPA].[BankAccount] AS a ON a.[BankBranchRef] = b.[BankBranchId] GROUP BY b.[Title] ORDER BY AccountCount DESC

records.question: Show the number of accounts for each bank branch along with the branch title, and list the top 20 branches with the highest account counts in descending order of account count.
records.reference_sql: SELECT TOP (20)  b.[Title], COUNT(a.[BankAccountId]) AS AccountCount FROM [RPA].[BankBranch] AS b LEFT JOIN [RPA].[BankAccount] AS a ON a.[BankBranchRef] = b.[BankBranchId] GROUP BY b.[Title] ORDER BY AccountCount DESC

records.question: مجموع مبلغ چک‌های دریافتی به ازای هر بانک چه مقدار است؟
records.reference_sql: SELECT b.[Title], b.[Title_En], SUM(rc.[Amount]) AS TotalAmount FROM [RPA].[Bank] AS b INNER JOIN [RPA].[ReceiptCheque] AS rc ON rc.[BankRef] = b.[BankId] GROUP BY b.[Title], b.[Title_En]

records.question: What is the total amount of receipt cheques for each bank, mention the bank title
records.reference_sql: SELECT b.[Title], SUM(rc.[Amount]) AS TotalAmount FROM [RPA].[Bank] AS b INNER JOIN [RPA].[ReceiptCheque] AS rc ON rc.[BankRef] = b.[BankId] GROUP BY b.[Title], b.[Title_En]

records.question: برای هر بانک، چند شعبه بانکی وجود دارد؟ فقط اسم و تعداد را بگو.
records.reference_sql: SELECT b.Title, COUNT(bb.BankBranchId) AS BranchCount FROM [RPA].[Bank] AS b LEFT JOIN [RPA].[BankBranch] AS bb ON bb.BankRef = b.BankId GROUP BY b.Title

records.question: For every bank, return only the bank name and its branch count. Include banks that have no branches and report their branch count as zero.
records.reference_sql: SELECT b.Title, COUNT(bb.BankBranchId) AS BranchCount FROM [RPA].[Bank] AS b LEFT JOIN [RPA].[BankBranch] AS bb ON bb.BankRef = b.BankId GROUP BY b.Title

records.question: برای هر سازنده چند بانک وجود دارد؟
records.reference_sql: SELECT [Creator], COUNT(*) AS [BankCount] FROM [RPA].[Bank] GROUP BY [Creator]

records.question: How many banks are there for each creator?
records.reference_sql: SELECT [Creator], COUNT(*) AS [BankCount] FROM [RPA].[Bank] GROUP BY [Creator]

records.question: ۲۰ حساب بانکی اول را به ترتیب صعودی شماره حساب، به همراه موجودی فعلی و موجودی تاریخی آن‌ها نشان دهید.
records.reference_sql: SELECT TOP (20) ba.[AccountNo],  ba.[Balance] AS CurrentBalance, bab.[Balance] AS HistoricalBalance FROM [RPA].[BankAccount] AS ba JOIN [RPA].[BankAccountBalance] AS bab ON bab.[BankAccountRef] = ba.[BankAccountId] ORDER BY ba.[AccountNo]

records.question: Show the first 20 bank accounts ordered by account number ascending, with their current balance and historical balance.
records.reference_sql: SELECT TOP (20) ba.[AccountNo],  ba.[Balance] AS CurrentBalance, bab.[Balance] AS HistoricalBalance FROM [RPA].[BankAccount] AS ba JOIN [RPA].[BankAccountBalance] AS bab ON bab.[BankAccountRef] = ba.[BankAccountId] ORDER BY ba.[AccountNo]

records.question: فهرست ۲۰ حساب بانکی برتر با شماره حساب، صاحب حساب، موجودی و عنوان نوع حساب به انگلیسی، به ترتیب نزولی موجودی.
records.reference_sql:
SELECT TOP (20) ba.[AccountNo], ba.[Owner], ba.[Balance], at.[Title_En]
FROM [RPA].[BankAccount] AS ba
JOIN [RPA].[AccountType] AS at ON ba.[AccountTypeRef] = at.[AccountTypeId]
ORDER BY ba.[Balance] DESC

records.question: List the top 20 bank accounts with their account numbers, owners, balances, and the account type title in English, ordered by balance descending.
records.reference_sql:
SELECT TOP (20) ba.[AccountNo], ba.[Owner], ba.[Balance], at.[Title_En]
FROM [RPA].[BankAccount] AS ba
JOIN [RPA].[AccountType] AS at ON ba.[AccountTypeRef] = at.[AccountTypeId]
ORDER BY ba.[Balance] DESC

records.question: بالا 20 حساب بانکی را به همراه شماره حساب، موجودی و نام شعبه نمایش دهید، به ترتیب موجودی نزولی.
records.reference_sql: SELECT TOP (20) ba.[AccountNo], ba.[Balance], bb.[Title] FROM [RPA].[BankAccount] AS ba INNER JOIN [RPA].[BankBranch] AS bb ON ba.[BankBranchRef] = bb.[BankBranchId] ORDER BY ba.[Balance] DESC

records.question: Show the top 20 bank accounts with their account number, balance, and branch title, ordered by balance descending.
records.reference_sql: SELECT TOP (20) ba.[AccountNo], ba.[Balance], bb.[Title] FROM [RPA].[BankAccount] AS ba INNER JOIN [RPA].[BankBranch] AS bb ON ba.[BankBranchRef] = bb.[BankBranchId] ORDER BY ba.[Balance] DESC

records.question: کل موجودی حساب‌ها به ازای هر سال مالی چقدر است؟
records.reference_sql: SELECT [FiscalYearRef], SUM([Balance]) AS [TotalBalance] FROM [RPA].[BankAccountBalance] GROUP BY [FiscalYearRef] ORDER BY [FiscalYearRef]

records.question: What is the total balance per fiscal year?
records.reference_sql: SELECT [FiscalYearRef], SUM([Balance]) AS [TotalBalance] FROM [RPA].[BankAccountBalance] GROUP BY [FiscalYearRef] ORDER BY [FiscalYearRef]

records.question: مجموع موجودی و تعداد حساب‌ها برای هر نوع حساب چیست؟
records.reference_sql: SELECT [RPA].[BankAccount].[AccountTypeRef], SUM([RPA].[BankAccount].[Balance]) AS TotalBalance, COUNT(*) AS AccountCount FROM [RPA].[BankAccount] GROUP BY [RPA].[BankAccount].[AccountTypeRef]

records.question: What is the total balance and the number of accounts for each account type?
records.reference_sql: SELECT [RPA].[BankAccount].[AccountTypeRef], SUM([RPA].[BankAccount].[Balance]) AS TotalBalance, COUNT(*) AS AccountCount FROM [RPA].[BankAccount] GROUP BY [RPA].[BankAccount].[AccountTypeRef]

records.question: عناوین (فارسی و انگلیسی) و موجودی فعلی حساب‌های نقدی، به همراه مجموع موجودی ثبت‌شده در جدول CashBalance برای هر حساب نقدی، 20 حساب برتر بر اساس مجموع موجودی را نشان دهید.
records.reference_sql: SELECT TOP (20) c.[Title], c.[Title_En], c.[Balance] AS CurrentBalance, SUM(cb.[Balance]) AS TotalCashBalance FROM [RPA].[Cash] AS c INNER JOIN [RPA].[CashBalance] AS cb ON cb.[CashRef] = c.[CashId] GROUP BY c.[CashId], c.[Title], c.[Title_En], c.[Balance] ORDER BY SUM(cb.[Balance]) DESC

records.question: What are the titles (both Persian and English) and current balances of cash accounts, along with the total balance recorded in CashBalance for each cash account, showing the top 20 accounts by total balance?
records.reference_sql: SELECT TOP (20) c.[Title], c.[Title_En], c.[Balance] AS CurrentBalance, SUM(cb.[Balance]) AS TotalCashBalance FROM [RPA].[Cash] AS c INNER JOIN [RPA].[CashBalance] AS cb ON cb.[CashRef] = c.[CashId] GROUP BY c.[CashId], c.[Title], c.[Title_En], c.[Balance] ORDER BY SUM(cb.[Balance]) DESC

records.question: عنوان (به فارسی و انگلیسی) هر رکورد نقدی و مجموع مبلغ پرداختی دریافت شده برای آن چیست؟
records.reference_sql: SELECT TOP (20) c.[Title], c.[Title_En], SUM(ph.[Amount]) AS TotalPaymentAmount FROM [RPA].[Cash] AS c LEFT JOIN [RPA].[PaymentHeader] AS ph ON ph.[CashRef] = c.[CashId] GROUP BY c.[Title], c.[Title_En] ORDER BY TotalPaymentAmount DESC

records.question: What is the title (both Persian and English) of each cash record and the total payment amount received for it?
records.reference_sql: SELECT TOP (20) c.[Title], c.[Title_En], SUM(ph.[Amount]) AS TotalPaymentAmount FROM [RPA].[Cash] AS c LEFT JOIN [RPA].[PaymentHeader] AS ph ON ph.[CashRef] = c.[CashId] GROUP BY c.[Title], c.[Title_En] ORDER BY TotalPaymentAmount DESC

records.question: برای هر رکورد نقدی، عنوان انگلیسی، موجودی فعلی و مجموع مبلغ چک‌های دریافت شده مرتبط را نشان دهید، به ترتیب مجموع مبلغ چک‌ها به صورت نزولی (۲۰ رکورد برتر).
records.reference_sql: SELECT TOP (20) c.[Title_En], c.[Balance], ISNULL(SUM(rc.[Amount]),0) AS TotalChequeAmount FROM [RPA].[Cash] AS c LEFT JOIN [RPA].[ReceiptCheque] AS rc ON rc.[CashRef]=c.[CashId] GROUP BY c.[Title_En], c.[Balance] ORDER BY TotalChequeAmount DESC

records.question: For each cash entry, show its English title, current balance, and the total amount of receipt cheques linked to it, ordered by total cheque amount descending (top 20).
records.reference_sql: SELECT TOP (20) c.[Title_En], c.[Balance], ISNULL(SUM(rc.[Amount]),0) AS TotalChequeAmount FROM [RPA].[Cash] AS c LEFT JOIN [RPA].[ReceiptCheque] AS rc ON rc.[CashRef]=c.[CashId] GROUP BY c.[Title_En], c.[Balance] ORDER BY TotalChequeAmount DESC

records.question: کل موجودی نقد برای هر سال مالی چقدر است؟
records.reference_sql: SELECT [FiscalYearRef], SUM([Balance]) AS TotalBalance FROM [RPA].[CashBalance] GROUP BY [FiscalYearRef] ORDER BY TotalBalance DESC

records.question: What is the total cash balance for each fiscal year?
records.reference_sql: SELECT [FiscalYearRef], SUM([Balance]) AS TotalBalance FROM [RPA].[CashBalance] GROUP BY [FiscalYearRef] ORDER BY TotalBalance DESC

records.question: مجموع موجودی برای هر ارز چیست؟
records.reference_sql: SELECT [RPA].[Cash].[CurrencyRef], SUM([RPA].[Cash].[Balance]) AS TotalBalance FROM [RPA].[Cash] GROUP BY [RPA].[Cash].[CurrencyRef]

records.question: What is the total balance for each currency?
records.reference_sql: SELECT [RPA].[Cash].[CurrencyRef], SUM([RPA].[Cash].[Balance]) AS TotalBalance FROM [RPA].[Cash] GROUP BY [RPA].[Cash].[CurrencyRef]

records.question: میانگین درصد برای هر نوع در جدول ضریب چیست؟
records.reference_sql: SELECT [CNT].[Coefficient].[Type], AVG([CNT].[Coefficient].[Percent]) AS AvgPercent FROM [CNT].[Coefficient] GROUP BY [CNT].[Coefficient].[Type]

records.question: What is the average Percent for each Type in the Coefficient table?
records.reference_sql: SELECT [CNT].[Coefficient].[Type], AVG([CNT].[Coefficient].[Percent]) AS AvgPercent FROM [CNT].[Coefficient] GROUP BY [CNT].[Coefficient].[Type]

records.question: تعداد رکوردهای هزینه توسط هر سازنده چقدر است؟
records.reference_sql: SELECT [Creator], COUNT(*) AS CostCount FROM [CNT].[Cost] GROUP BY [Creator] ORDER BY CostCount DESC

records.question: How many cost records were created by each creator?
records.reference_sql: SELECT [Creator], COUNT(*) AS CostCount FROM [CNT].[Cost] GROUP BY [Creator] ORDER BY CostCount DESC

records.question: فهرست 20 عنوان گارانتی به همراه تاریخ ایجاد، به ترتیب تاریخ ایجاد نزولی.
records.reference_sql: SELECT TOP (20) [Title], [CreationDate] FROM [CNT].[Warranty] ORDER BY [CreationDate] DESC

records.question: List the top 20 warranty titles with their creation dates, ordered by creation date descending.
records.reference_sql: SELECT TOP (20) [Title], [CreationDate] FROM [CNT].[Warranty] ORDER BY [CreationDate] DESC

records.question: برای هر Type، متوسط Percent و تعداد ضریب‌ها چه مقدار است؟
records.reference_sql: SELECT [CNT].[Coefficient].[Type], AVG([CNT].[Coefficient].[Percent]) AS AvgPercent, COUNT(*) AS CoefficientCount FROM [CNT].[Coefficient] GROUP BY [CNT].[Coefficient].[Type] ORDER BY [CNT].[Coefficient].[Type]

records.question: What is the average Percent and how many coefficients exist for each Type?
records.reference_sql: SELECT [CNT].[Coefficient].[Type], AVG([CNT].[Coefficient].[Percent]) AS AvgPercent, COUNT(*) AS CoefficientCount FROM [CNT].[Coefficient] GROUP BY [CNT].[Coefficient].[Type] ORDER BY [CNT].[Coefficient].[Type]

records.question: هر سازنده چند رکورد هزینه دارد؟
records.reference_sql: SELECT [Creator] AS Creator, COUNT(*) AS RecordCount FROM [CNT].[Cost] GROUP BY [Creator] ORDER BY RecordCount DESC

records.question: How many cost records does each creator have?
records.reference_sql: SELECT [Creator] AS Creator, COUNT(*) AS RecordCount FROM [CNT].[Cost] GROUP BY [Creator] ORDER BY RecordCount DESC

records.question: عنوان‌های سال‌های مالی و تعداد رسیدهای خرید ثبت‌شده در هر یک چه‌است، ۲۰ سال با بیشترین تعداد رسید را نشان دهید؟
records.reference_sql: SELECT TOP (20) FY.[Title] AS FiscalYearTitle, COUNT(AR.[AcquisitionReceiptID]) AS ReceiptCount FROM [FMK].[FiscalYear] AS FY LEFT JOIN [AST].[AcquisitionReceipt] AS AR ON AR.[FiscalYearRef] = FY.[FiscalYearId] GROUP BY FY.[Title] ORDER BY ReceiptCount DESC

records.question: What are the titles of fiscal years and how many acquisition receipts were recorded in each, showing the top 20 years with the highest receipt counts?
records.reference_sql: SELECT TOP (20) FY.[Title] AS FiscalYearTitle, COUNT(AR.[AcquisitionReceiptID]) AS ReceiptCount FROM [FMK].[FiscalYear] AS FY LEFT JOIN [AST].[AcquisitionReceipt] AS AR ON AR.[FiscalYearRef] = FY.[FiscalYearId] GROUP BY FY.[Title] ORDER BY ReceiptCount DESC

records.question: آخرین ۲۰ تراکنش دارایی چیست که شناسه تراکنش، تاریخ فعالیت، نوع تراکنش و عنوان سال مالی مربوطه را نشان می‌دهد و بر اساس تاریخ فعالیت به ترتیب نزولی مرتب شده‌اند؟
records.reference_sql: SELECT TOP (20)      at.[AssetTransactionID],      at.[ActivityDate],      at.[TransactionType],      fy.[Title] AS FiscalYearTitle  FROM [AST].[AssetTransaction] AS at  INNER JOIN [FMK].[FiscalYear] AS fy      ON at.[FiscalYearRef] = fy.[FiscalYearId]  ORDER BY at.[ActivityDate] DESC

records.question: What are the latest 20 asset transactions, showing their transaction ID, activity date, transaction type, and the title of the fiscal year they belong to, ordered by activity date descending?
records.reference_sql: SELECT TOP (20)      at.[AssetTransactionID],      at.[ActivityDate],      at.[TransactionType],      fy.[Title] AS FiscalYearTitle  FROM [AST].[AssetTransaction] AS at  INNER JOIN [FMK].[FiscalYear] AS fy      ON at.[FiscalYearRef] = fy.[FiscalYearId]  ORDER BY at.[ActivityDate] DESC

records.question: برای هر سال مالی، عنوان، تاریخ شروع و تاریخ پایان را به همراه تعداد عملیات بسته شدن مرتبط نمایش دهید.
records.reference_sql: SELECT FY.Title, FY.StartDate, FY.EndDate, COUNT(CO.ClosingOperationId) AS ClosingCount FROM [FMK].[FiscalYear] AS FY LEFT JOIN [GNR].[ClosingOperation] AS CO ON CO.FiscalYearRef = FY.FiscalYearId GROUP BY FY.Title, FY.StartDate, FY.EndDate ORDER BY FY.StartDate DESC

records.question: For each fiscal year, show the title, start date, end date, and the number of associated closing operations.
records.reference_sql: SELECT FY.Title, FY.StartDate, FY.EndDate, COUNT(CO.ClosingOperationId) AS ClosingCount FROM [FMK].[FiscalYear] AS FY LEFT JOIN [GNR].[ClosingOperation] AS CO ON CO.FiscalYearRef = FY.FiscalYearId GROUP BY FY.Title, FY.StartDate, FY.EndDate ORDER BY FY.StartDate DESC

records.question: تعداد سال‌های مالی برای هر وضعیت چیست؟
records.reference_sql: SELECT [Status], COUNT(*) AS [YearCount] FROM [FMK].[FiscalYear] GROUP BY [Status] ORDER BY [Status]

records.question: What is the count of fiscal years for each status?
records.reference_sql: SELECT [Status], COUNT(*) AS [YearCount] FROM [FMK].[FiscalYear] GROUP BY [Status] ORDER BY [Status]

records.question: برای هر وضعیت، چند سال مالی وجود دارد؟
records.reference_sql: SELECT [Status], COUNT(*) AS [YearCount] FROM [FMK].[FiscalYear] GROUP BY [Status] ORDER BY [YearCount] DESC

records.question: How many fiscal years exist for each status?
records.reference_sql: SELECT [Status], COUNT(*) AS [YearCount] FROM [FMK].[FiscalYear] GROUP BY [Status] ORDER BY [YearCount] DESC

records.question: لیست نام‌های انگلیسی طرف‌ها و عناوین آدرس‌های اصلی آن‌ها را نمایش دهید، حداکثر ۲۰ نتیجه به ترتیب نام طرف.
records.reference_sql: SELECT TOP (20) p.[Name_En] AS PartyName, a.[Title] AS MainAddressTitle FROM [GNR].[Party] AS p INNER JOIN [GNR].[PartyAddress] AS a ON a.[PartyRef] = p.[PartyId] WHERE a.[IsMain] = 1 ORDER BY p.[Name_En]

records.question: List the English names of parties and the titles of their main addresses, showing up to 20 results ordered by party name.
records.reference_sql: SELECT TOP (20) p.[Name_En] AS PartyName, a.[Title] AS MainAddressTitle FROM [GNR].[Party] AS p INNER JOIN [GNR].[PartyAddress] AS a ON a.[PartyRef] = p.[PartyId] WHERE a.[IsMain] = 1 ORDER BY p.[Name_En]

records.question: بالا ۲۰ طرف حساب با بیشترین موجودی افتتاحیه چیستند؟ شناسه طرف، نام (فارسی و انگلیسی)، مقدار موجودی افتتاحیه و مرجع سال مالی را نشان دهید.
records.reference_sql: SELECT TOP (20) p.[PartyId], p.[Name], p.[Name_En], ob.[OpeningBalance], ob.[FiscalYearRef]  FROM [GNR].[Party] AS p  INNER JOIN [GNR].[PartyOpeningBalance] AS ob ON ob.[PartyRef] = p.[PartyId]  ORDER BY ob.[OpeningBalance] DESC

records.question: What are the top 20 parties with the highest opening balances, showing their Party ID, name (both Persian and English), opening balance amount, and fiscal year reference?
records.reference_sql: SELECT TOP (20) p.[PartyId], p.[Name], p.[Name_En], ob.[OpeningBalance], ob.[FiscalYearRef]  FROM [GNR].[Party] AS p  INNER JOIN [GNR].[PartyOpeningBalance] AS ob ON ob.[PartyRef] = p.[PartyId]  ORDER BY ob.[OpeningBalance] DESC

records.question: پارتی‌های دارای شماره تلفن اصلی را به همراه شناسه، نام، نوع تلفن و وضعیت اصلی بودن تلفنشان لیست کنید.
records.reference_sql: SELECT TOP (20) p.[PartyId], p.[Name], pp.[Type] AS PhoneType, pp.[IsMain]  FROM [GNR].[Party] AS p  INNER JOIN [GNR].[PartyPhone] AS pp ON pp.[PartyRef] = p.[PartyId]  ORDER BY p.[PartyId]

records.question: List the first 20 parties that have a main phone entry, showing their PartyId, Name, phone Type and whether the phone is marked as main.
records.reference_sql: SELECT TOP (20) p.[PartyId], p.[Name], pp.[Type] AS PhoneType, pp.[IsMain]  FROM [GNR].[Party] AS p  INNER JOIN [GNR].[PartyPhone] AS pp ON pp.[PartyRef] = p.[PartyId]  ORDER BY p.[PartyId]

records.question: چند طرف برای هر نوع وجود دارد؟
records.reference_sql: SELECT [Type], COUNT(*) AS PartyCount FROM [GNR].[Party] GROUP BY [Type] ORDER BY PartyCount DESC

records.question: How many parties are there for each Type?
records.reference_sql: SELECT [Type], COUNT(*) AS PartyCount FROM [GNR].[Party] GROUP BY [Type] ORDER BY PartyCount DESC

records.question: پیشنهاد 20 ارز با بیشترین واحد تبدیل را به همراه عنوان انگلیسی، واحد تبدیل و تعداد دقت نمایش دهید، به ترتیب نزولی واحد تبدیل.
records.reference_sql: SELECT TOP (20) [Title_En] AS [EnglishTitle], [ExchangeUnit], [PrecisionCount]  FROM [GNR].[Currency]  ORDER BY [ExchangeUnit] DESC

records.question: Show the top 20 currencies with the highest exchange unit, displaying the English title, exchange unit, and precision count, ordered by exchange unit descending.
records.reference_sql: SELECT TOP (20) [Title_En] AS [EnglishTitle], [ExchangeUnit], [PrecisionCount]  FROM [GNR].[Currency]  ORDER BY [ExchangeUnit] DESC

records.question: مجموع قیمت خالص اقلام برای هر فاکتور را به همراه شماره فاکتور و نام مشتری نشان دهید.
records.reference_sql: SELECT TOP (20)      i.[Number] AS InvoiceNumber,      i.[CustomerRealName] AS CustomerName,      SUM(ii.[NetPrice]) AS TotalItemNetPrice  FROM [SLS].[Invoice] AS i  INNER JOIN [SLS].[InvoiceItem] AS ii      ON ii.[InvoiceRef] = i.[InvoiceId]  GROUP BY i.[Number], i.[CustomerRealName]  ORDER BY TotalItemNetPrice DESC

records.question: What is the total net price of items for each invoice, showing the invoice number and customer name?
records.reference_sql: SELECT TOP (20)      i.[Number] AS InvoiceNumber,      i.[CustomerRealName] AS CustomerName,      SUM(ii.[NetPrice]) AS TotalItemNetPrice  FROM [SLS].[Invoice] AS i  INNER JOIN [SLS].[InvoiceItem] AS ii      ON ii.[InvoiceRef] = i.[InvoiceId]  GROUP BY i.[Number], i.[CustomerRealName]  ORDER BY TotalItemNetPrice DESC

records.question: شناسهٔ آیتم فاکتور و مجموع مقادیر فاکتور افزودنی از جدول InvoiceItemAdditionFactor را برای هر آیتم فاکتور نشان دهید، به ترتیب نزولی مجموع فاکتور افزودنی، اولین ۲۰ مورد.
records.reference_sql: SELECT TOP (20) i.[InvoiceItemID], SUM(a.[Value]) AS [TotalAdditionFactor] FROM [SLS].[InvoiceItem] AS i JOIN [SLS].[InvoiceItemAdditionFactor] AS a ON a.[InvoiceItemRef] = i.[InvoiceItemID] GROUP BY i.[InvoiceItemID] ORDER BY [TotalAdditionFactor] DESC

records.question: Show the InvoiceItemID and the sum of AdditionFactor values from InvoiceItemAdditionFactor for each invoice item, ordered by the total addition factor descending, top 20.
records.reference_sql: SELECT TOP (20) i.[InvoiceItemID], SUM(a.[Value]) AS [TotalAdditionFactor] FROM [SLS].[InvoiceItem] AS i JOIN [SLS].[InvoiceItemAdditionFactor] AS a ON a.[InvoiceItemRef] = i.[InvoiceItemID] GROUP BY i.[InvoiceItemID] ORDER BY [TotalAdditionFactor] DESC

records.question: فهرست ۲۰ فاکتور برتر به همراه عنوان نوع فروش و قیمت خالص به ارز پایه، به ترتیب نزولی قیمت خالص.
records.reference_sql: SELECT TOP (20) i.[Number] AS InvoiceNumber, st.[Title] AS SaleTypeTitle, i.[NetPriceInBaseCurrency] FROM [SLS].[Invoice] i JOIN [SLS].[SaleType] st ON i.[SaleTypeRef] = st.[SaleTypeId] ORDER BY i.[NetPriceInBaseCurrency] DESC

records.question: List the top 20 invoices with their sale type titles and net price in base currency, ordered by net price descending.
records.reference_sql: SELECT TOP (20) i.[Number] AS InvoiceNumber, st.[Title] AS SaleTypeTitle, i.[NetPriceInBaseCurrency] FROM [SLS].[Invoice] i JOIN [SLS].[SaleType] st ON i.[SaleTypeRef] = st.[SaleTypeId] ORDER BY i.[NetPriceInBaseCurrency] DESC

records.question: عناوین قالب‌ها را به همراه تعداد مخاطبان مرتبط با هر قالب لیست کنید، به ترتیب تعداد نزولی و فقط 20 مورد برتر.
records.reference_sql: SELECT TOP (20) t.[Title], COUNT(tc.[TemplateContactID]) AS [ContactCount] FROM [MSG].[Template] AS t LEFT JOIN [MSG].[TemplateContact] AS tc ON tc.[TemplateRef] = t.[TemplateID] GROUP BY t.[Title] ORDER BY [ContactCount] DESC

records.question: List the titles of templates along with the number of contacts associated with each template, ordered by the contact count descending, showing the top 20 templates.
records.reference_sql: SELECT TOP (20) t.[Title], COUNT(tc.[TemplateContactID]) AS [ContactCount] FROM [MSG].[Template] AS t LEFT JOIN [MSG].[TemplateContact] AS tc ON tc.[TemplateRef] = t.[TemplateID] GROUP BY t.[Title] ORDER BY [ContactCount] DESC

records.question: تعداد فیلترهای تعریف‌شده برای هر قالب را به‌صورت عنوان قالب و شمارش فیلتر نمایش دهید، به‌صورت نزولی بر اساس شمارش مرتب شود.
records.reference_sql: SELECT TOP (20) t.[Title], COUNT(tf.[TemplateFilterID]) AS FilterCount FROM [MSG].[Template] AS t LEFT JOIN [MSG].[TemplateFilter] AS tf ON tf.[TemplateRef] = t.[TemplateID] GROUP BY t.[Title] ORDER BY FilterCount DESC

records.question: What is the number of filters defined for each template, showing the template title and filter count, ordered by the count descending?
records.reference_sql: SELECT TOP (20) t.[Title], COUNT(tf.[TemplateFilterID]) AS FilterCount FROM [MSG].[Template] AS t LEFT JOIN [MSG].[TemplateFilter] AS tf ON tf.[TemplateRef] = t.[TemplateID] GROUP BY t.[Title] ORDER BY FilterCount DESC

records.question: عنوان‌ها و تاریخ‌های ایجاد آخرین ۲۰ قالب چیست و برای هر قالب شناسهٔ برنامه‌ریزی مرتبط چیست؟
records.reference_sql:
SELECT TOP (20) t.[Title], t.[CreationDate], ts.[SchedulingRef]
FROM [MSG].[Template] AS t
LEFT JOIN [MSG].[TemplateScheduling] AS ts ON ts.[TemplateRef] = t.[TemplateID]
ORDER BY t.[CreationDate] DESC

records.question: What are the titles and creation dates of the latest 20 templates, and what scheduling reference is associated with each template?
records.reference_sql:
SELECT TOP (20) t.[Title], t.[CreationDate], ts.[SchedulingRef]
FROM [MSG].[Template] AS t
LEFT JOIN [MSG].[TemplateScheduling] AS ts ON ts.[TemplateRef] = t.[TemplateID]
ORDER BY t.[CreationDate] DESC

records.question: برای هر قالب، چند رکورد زمان‌بندی وجود دارد؟
records.reference_sql: SELECT [TemplateRef], COUNT(*) AS [ScheduleCount] FROM [MSG].[TemplateScheduling] GROUP BY [TemplateRef]

records.question: How many scheduling records are there for each template?
records.reference_sql: SELECT [TemplateRef], COUNT(*) AS [ScheduleCount] FROM [MSG].[TemplateScheduling] GROUP BY [TemplateRef]

records.question: هر سازنده چند قالب دارد؟
records.reference_sql:
SELECT [Creator], COUNT(*) AS [TemplateCount]
FROM [MSG].[Template]
GROUP BY [Creator]
ORDER BY [TemplateCount] DESC

records.question: How many templates does each creator have?
records.reference_sql:
SELECT [Creator], COUNT(*) AS [TemplateCount]
FROM [MSG].[Template]
GROUP BY [Creator]
ORDER BY [TemplateCount] DESC

records.question: شماره پرداخت، تاریخ پرداخت، مبلغ پرداخت و شماره و تاریخ رسید مربوط به آخرین 20 پرداختی که رسید مرتبط دارند را نمایش دهید.
records.reference_sql: SELECT TOP (20) ph.[Number] AS PaymentNumber, ph.[Date] AS PaymentDate, ph.[Amount] AS PaymentAmount, rh.[Number] AS ReceiptNumber, rh.[Date] AS ReceiptDate FROM [RPA].[PaymentHeader] ph INNER JOIN [RPA].[ReceiptHeader] rh ON ph.[ReceiptHeaderRef] = rh.[ReceiptHeaderId] ORDER BY ph.[Date] DESC

records.question: Show the payment number, payment date, payment amount, and the corresponding receipt number and receipt date for the latest 20 payments that have an associated receipt.
records.reference_sql: SELECT TOP (20) ph.[Number] AS PaymentNumber, ph.[Date] AS PaymentDate, ph.[Amount] AS PaymentAmount, rh.[Number] AS ReceiptNumber, rh.[Date] AS ReceiptDate FROM [RPA].[PaymentHeader] ph INNER JOIN [RPA].[ReceiptHeader] rh ON ph.[ReceiptHeaderRef] = rh.[ReceiptHeaderId] ORDER BY ph.[Date] DESC

records.question: برای هر سرعنوان پرداخت، چند چک مرتبط است را نشان دهید؛ شماره سرعنوان و تعداد چک‌ها را به‌صورت مرتب‌شده بر اساس بیشترین تعداد نمایش دهید.
records.reference_sql: SELECT TOP (20) ph.[Number] AS HeaderNumber, COUNT(pc.[PaymentChequeId]) AS ChequeCount FROM [RPA].[PaymentHeader] ph INNER JOIN [RPA].[PaymentCheque] pc ON pc.[PaymentHeaderRef] = ph.[PaymentHeaderId] GROUP BY ph.[Number] ORDER BY ChequeCount DESC

records.question: For each payment header, how many cheques are linked, showing the header number and the count of cheques, ordered by the highest count?
records.reference_sql: SELECT TOP (20) ph.[Number] AS HeaderNumber, COUNT(pc.[PaymentChequeId]) AS ChequeCount FROM [RPA].[PaymentHeader] ph INNER JOIN [RPA].[PaymentCheque] pc ON pc.[PaymentHeaderRef] = ph.[PaymentHeaderId] GROUP BY ph.[Number] ORDER BY ChequeCount DESC

records.question: مجموع و متوسط مبلغ رسید برای هر وضعیت چیست و در هر وضعیت چند رسید وجود دارد؟
records.reference_sql: SELECT [RPA].[ReceiptHeader].[State],SUM([RPA].[ReceiptHeader].[TotalAmount]) AS TotalAmountSum,AVG([RPA].[ReceiptHeader].[TotalAmount]) AS AvgTotalAmount,COUNT(*) AS ReceiptCount FROM [RPA].[ReceiptHeader] GROUP BY [RPA].[ReceiptHeader].[State] ORDER BY TotalAmountSum DESC

records.question: What is the total and average receipt amount for each state, and how many receipts are in each state?
records.reference_sql: SELECT [RPA].[ReceiptHeader].[State],SUM([RPA].[ReceiptHeader].[TotalAmount]) AS TotalAmountSum,AVG([RPA].[ReceiptHeader].[TotalAmount]) AS AvgTotalAmount,COUNT(*) AS ReceiptCount FROM [RPA].[ReceiptHeader] GROUP BY [RPA].[ReceiptHeader].[State] ORDER BY TotalAmountSum DESC

records.question: مجموع مبلغ پرداختی و مجموع مبلغ به ارز پایه برای هر نوع پرداخت چه مقدار است؟
records.reference_sql: SELECT TOP (20) [RPA].[PaymentHeader].[Type], SUM([RPA].[PaymentHeader].[PaymentAmount]) AS TotalPaymentAmount, SUM([RPA].[PaymentHeader].[AmountInBaseCurrency]) AS TotalBaseAmount FROM [RPA].[PaymentHeader] GROUP BY [RPA].[PaymentHeader].[Type] ORDER BY TotalPaymentAmount DESC

records.question: What is the total payment amount and total amount in base currency for each payment type?
records.reference_sql: SELECT TOP (20) [RPA].[PaymentHeader].[Type], SUM([RPA].[PaymentHeader].[PaymentAmount]) AS TotalPaymentAmount, SUM([RPA].[PaymentHeader].[AmountInBaseCurrency]) AS TotalBaseAmount FROM [RPA].[PaymentHeader] GROUP BY [RPA].[PaymentHeader].[Type] ORDER BY TotalPaymentAmount DESC

records.question: لیست 20 شعبهٔ بانکی اول به همراه عنوان شعبه، کد و نام بانکی که به آن تعلق دارند را نمایش دهید.
records.reference_sql: SELECT TOP (20) bb.[BankBranchId], bb.[Title] AS BranchTitle, bb.[Code] AS BranchCode, b.[Title] AS BankTitle FROM [RPA].[BankBranch] AS bb INNER JOIN [RPA].[Bank] AS b ON bb.[BankRef] = b.[BankId] ORDER BY bb.[BankBranchId]

records.question: List the first 20 bank branches with their branch title, code, and the name of the bank they belong to.
records.reference_sql: SELECT TOP (20) bb.[BankBranchId], bb.[Title] AS BranchTitle, bb.[Code] AS BranchCode, b.[Title] AS BankTitle FROM [RPA].[BankBranch] AS bb INNER JOIN [RPA].[Bank] AS b ON bb.[BankRef] = b.[BankId] ORDER BY bb.[BankBranchId]

records.question: لیست 20 شعبه بانکی اول به همراه کد، عنوان (فارسی و انگلیسی) و عناوین (فارسی و انگلیسی) مکان‌های مربوطه را نمایش دهید.
records.reference_sql: SELECT TOP (20) bb.[BankBranchId], bb.[Code] AS BranchCode, bb.[Title] AS BranchTitle, bb.[Title_En] AS BranchTitleEn, loc.[Title] AS LocationTitle, loc.[Title_En] AS LocationTitleEn FROM [RPA].[BankBranch] AS bb INNER JOIN [GNR].[Location] AS loc ON bb.[LocationRef] = loc.[LocationId] ORDER BY bb.[BankBranchId]

records.question: List the first 20 bank branches with their codes, titles (both Persian and English), and the titles (both Persian and English) of their locations.
records.reference_sql: SELECT TOP (20) bb.[BankBranchId], bb.[Code] AS BranchCode, bb.[Title] AS BranchTitle, bb.[Title_En] AS BranchTitleEn, loc.[Title] AS LocationTitle, loc.[Title_En] AS LocationTitleEn FROM [RPA].[BankBranch] AS bb INNER JOIN [GNR].[Location] AS loc ON bb.[LocationRef] = loc.[LocationId] ORDER BY bb.[BankBranchId]

records.question: شناسه پرسنل، شماره حساب و عنوان انگلیسی نوع حساب را برای هر پرسنل به ترتیب شناسه پرسنل نشان دهید (اولین ۲۰ رکورد).
records.reference_sql:
SELECT TOP (20) p.[PersonnelId], p.[AccountNo], at.[Title_En]
FROM [PAY].[Personnel] AS p
LEFT JOIN [RPA].[AccountType] AS at ON p.[AccountTypeRef] = at.[AccountTypeId]
ORDER BY p.[PersonnelId]

records.question: Show the PersonnelId, AccountNo, and the English title of the account type for each personnel, ordered by PersonnelId (top 20).
records.reference_sql:
SELECT TOP (20) p.[PersonnelId], p.[AccountNo], at.[Title_En]
FROM [PAY].[Personnel] AS p
LEFT JOIN [RPA].[AccountType] AS at ON p.[AccountTypeRef] = at.[AccountTypeId]
ORDER BY p.[PersonnelId]

records.question: در هر سال چه تعداد بانک ایجاد شده‌اند؟
records.reference_sql: SELECT YEAR([RPA].[Bank].[CreationDate]) AS [Year], COUNT(*) AS [BankCount] FROM [RPA].[Bank] GROUP BY YEAR([RPA].[Bank].[CreationDate]) ORDER BY [Year]

records.question: How many banks were created each year?
records.reference_sql: SELECT YEAR([RPA].[Bank].[CreationDate]) AS [Year], COUNT(*) AS [BankCount] FROM [RPA].[Bank] GROUP BY YEAR([RPA].[Bank].[CreationDate]) ORDER BY [Year]

records.question: تعداد شعب بانک در هر مکان چقدر است؟
records.reference_sql: SELECT [LocationRef], COUNT(*) AS [BranchCount] FROM [RPA].[BankBranch] GROUP BY [LocationRef]

records.question: How many bank branches are there for each location?
records.reference_sql: SELECT [LocationRef], COUNT(*) AS [BranchCount] FROM [RPA].[BankBranch] GROUP BY [LocationRef]

records.question: فهرست ۲۰ کالای برتر بر اساس کل مقدار خریداری‌شده، به‌همراه کد هر کالا و مجموع مقدار خریداری‌شده.
records.reference_sql: SELECT TOP (20) i.[Code] AS ItemCode, SUM(ii.[Quantity]) AS TotalQuantity FROM [INV].[Item] AS i JOIN [INV].[InventoryPurchaseInvoiceItem] AS ii ON ii.[ItemRef] = i.[ItemID] GROUP BY i.[Code] ORDER BY SUM(ii.[Quantity]) DESC

records.question: List the top 20 items by total purchased quantity, showing each item's code and the total quantity purchased.
records.reference_sql: SELECT TOP (20) i.[Code] AS ItemCode, SUM(ii.[Quantity]) AS TotalQuantity FROM [INV].[Item] AS i JOIN [INV].[InventoryPurchaseInvoiceItem] AS ii ON ii.[ItemRef] = i.[ItemID] GROUP BY i.[Code] ORDER BY SUM(ii.[Quantity]) DESC

records.question: 20 مورد برتر آیتم‌های فاکتور با مقدار Quantity، Price، ضریب افزودنی موثر بر مالیات بر ارزش افزوده و مجموع مقدار افزودنی در ارز پایه چیست؟
records.reference_sql: SELECT TOP (20)       ii.[InvoiceItemID],       ii.[Quantity],       ii.[Price],       ii.[AdditionFactor_VatEffective],       SUM(iiaf.[ValueInBaseCurrency]) AS TotalAdditionFactorBase   FROM [SLS].[InvoiceItem] AS ii   LEFT JOIN [SLS].[InvoiceItemAdditionFactor] AS iiaf       ON iiaf.[InvoiceItemRef] = ii.[InvoiceItemID]   GROUP BY ii.[InvoiceItemID], ii.[Quantity], ii.[Price], ii.[AdditionFactor_VatEffective]   ORDER BY ii.[InvoiceItemID]

records.question: What are the top 20 invoice items with their Quantity, Price, VAT‑effective addition factor, and total addition‑factor value in base currency?
records.reference_sql: SELECT TOP (20)       ii.[InvoiceItemID],       ii.[Quantity],       ii.[Price],       ii.[AdditionFactor_VatEffective],       SUM(iiaf.[ValueInBaseCurrency]) AS TotalAdditionFactorBase   FROM [SLS].[InvoiceItem] AS ii   LEFT JOIN [SLS].[InvoiceItemAdditionFactor] AS iiaf       ON iiaf.[InvoiceItemRef] = ii.[InvoiceItemID]   GROUP BY ii.[InvoiceItemID], ii.[Quantity], ii.[Price], ii.[AdditionFactor_VatEffective]   ORDER BY ii.[InvoiceItemID]

records.question: فهرست ۲۰ مورد برتر فاکتور با شماره فاکتور، نام مشتری، مقدار و قیمت خالص به ارز پایه، به ترتیب نزولی قیمت خالص را نمایش دهید.
records.reference_sql: SELECT TOP (20) ii.InvoiceRef, i.Number AS InvoiceNumber, i.CustomerRealName, ii.Quantity, ii.NetPriceInBaseCurrency FROM [SLS].[InvoiceItem] AS ii JOIN [SLS].[Invoice] AS i ON ii.InvoiceRef = i.InvoiceId ORDER BY ii.NetPriceInBaseCurrency DESC

records.question: List the top 20 invoice items with their invoice number, customer name, quantity, and net price in base currency, ordered by net price descending.
records.reference_sql: SELECT TOP (20) ii.InvoiceRef, i.Number AS InvoiceNumber, i.CustomerRealName, ii.Quantity, ii.NetPriceInBaseCurrency FROM [SLS].[InvoiceItem] AS ii JOIN [SLS].[Invoice] AS i ON ii.InvoiceRef = i.InvoiceId ORDER BY ii.NetPriceInBaseCurrency DESC

records.question: کل قیمت خالص به ارز پایه و کل مقدار برای هر توضیح آیتم فاکتور چیست، به‌صورت 20 توضیح برتر بر اساس کل قیمت خالص نمایش داده شود؟
records.reference_sql: SELECT TOP (20) [SLS].[InvoiceItem].[Description], SUM([SLS].[InvoiceItem].[NetPriceInBaseCurrency]) AS TotalNetPriceInBaseCurrency, SUM([SLS].[InvoiceItem].[Quantity]) AS TotalQuantity FROM [SLS].[InvoiceItem] GROUP BY [SLS].[InvoiceItem].[Description] ORDER BY TotalNetPriceInBaseCurrency DESC

records.question: What are the total net price in base currency and total quantity for each invoice item description, showing the top 20 descriptions by total net price?
records.reference_sql: SELECT TOP (20) [SLS].[InvoiceItem].[Description], SUM([SLS].[InvoiceItem].[NetPriceInBaseCurrency]) AS TotalNetPriceInBaseCurrency, SUM([SLS].[InvoiceItem].[Quantity]) AS TotalQuantity FROM [SLS].[InvoiceItem] GROUP BY [SLS].[InvoiceItem].[Description] ORDER BY TotalNetPriceInBaseCurrency DESC

records.question: برای هر نوع کالا، چند مورد وجود دارد؟
records.reference_sql: SELECT TOP 20 [Type] AS ItemType, COUNT(*) AS ItemCount FROM [INV].[Item] GROUP BY [Type] ORDER BY ItemCount DESC

records.question: How many items are there for each item type?
records.reference_sql: SELECT TOP 20 [Type] AS ItemType, COUNT(*) AS ItemCount FROM [INV].[Item] GROUP BY [Type] ORDER BY ItemCount DESC

records.question: برای هر جدول مالیات، چند مورد مالیاتی تعریف شده است و عنوان آن‌ها چیست؟
records.reference_sql: SELECT TOP (20) tt.[Title], tt.[Title_En], COUNT(ti.[TaxTableItemId]) AS ItemCount FROM [PAY].[TaxTable] AS tt JOIN [PAY].[TaxTableItem] AS ti ON ti.[TaxTableRef] = tt.[TaxTableId] GROUP BY tt.[Title], tt.[Title_En] ORDER BY ItemCount DESC

records.question: How many tax items are defined for each tax table, and what are their titles?
records.reference_sql: SELECT TOP (20) tt.[Title], tt.[Title_En], COUNT(ti.[TaxTableItemId]) AS ItemCount FROM [PAY].[TaxTable] AS tt JOIN [PAY].[TaxTableItem] AS ti ON ti.[TaxTableRef] = tt.[TaxTableId] GROUP BY tt.[Title], tt.[Title_En] ORDER BY ItemCount DESC

records.question: لیست هر گروه مالیاتی به همراه عنوان فارسی و انگلیسی آن و تعداد جدول‌های مالیاتی مرتبط با آن را به ترتیب تعداد نزولی (تا 20 رکورد) نشان دهید.
records.reference_sql: SELECT TOP (20) tg.[Title], tg.[Title_En], COUNT(tt.[TaxTableId]) AS TableCount FROM [PAY].[TaxGroup] tg JOIN [PAY].[TaxTable] tt ON tt.[TaxGroupRef] = tg.[TaxGroupId] GROUP BY tg.[Title], tg.[Title_En] ORDER BY TableCount DESC

records.question: List each tax group with its English and Persian titles and the number of tax tables associated with it, ordered by the count descending (top 20).
records.reference_sql: SELECT TOP (20) tg.[Title], tg.[Title_En], COUNT(tt.[TaxTableId]) AS TableCount FROM [PAY].[TaxGroup] tg JOIN [PAY].[TaxTable] tt ON tt.[TaxGroupRef] = tg.[TaxGroupId] GROUP BY tg.[Title], tg.[Title_En] ORDER BY TableCount DESC

records.question: برای هر گروه مالیاتی، تعداد قراردادهای مرتبط و مجموع مبلغ غیرقابل مالیات آن قراردادها چقدر است؟
records.reference_sql: SELECT tg.[Title] AS [Title],tg.[Title_En] AS [Title_En],COUNT(c.[Number]) AS [ContractCount],SUM(c.[NonTaxableAmount]) AS [TotalNonTaxableAmount] FROM [PAY].[TaxGroup] AS tg LEFT JOIN [PAY].[Contract] AS c ON c.[TaxGroupRef]=tg.[TaxGroupId] GROUP BY tg.[Title],tg.[Title_En] ORDER BY [ContractCount] DESC

records.question: For each tax group, how many contracts are linked and what is the total non‑taxable amount of those contracts?
records.reference_sql: SELECT tg.[Title] AS [Title],tg.[Title_En] AS [Title_En],COUNT(c.[Number]) AS [ContractCount],SUM(c.[NonTaxableAmount]) AS [TotalNonTaxableAmount] FROM [PAY].[TaxGroup] AS tg LEFT JOIN [PAY].[Contract] AS c ON c.[TaxGroupRef]=tg.[TaxGroupId] GROUP BY tg.[Title],tg.[Title_En] ORDER BY [ContractCount] DESC

records.question: برای هر نوع، چند گروه مالیاتی وجود دارد؟
records.reference_sql: SELECT [Type], COUNT(*) AS GroupCount FROM [PAY].[TaxGroup] GROUP BY [Type] ORDER BY [Type]

records.question: How many tax groups exist for each Type?
records.reference_sql: SELECT [Type], COUNT(*) AS GroupCount FROM [PAY].[TaxGroup] GROUP BY [Type] ORDER BY [Type]

records.question: برای هر نوع مالیات، چند رکورد مالیاتی وجود دارد؟
records.reference_sql: SELECT [PAY].[TaxTable].[TaxType], COUNT(*) AS RecordCount FROM [PAY].[TaxTable] GROUP BY [PAY].[TaxTable].[TaxType]

records.question: How many tax records exist for each tax type?
records.reference_sql: SELECT [PAY].[TaxTable].[TaxType], COUNT(*) AS RecordCount FROM [PAY].[TaxTable] GROUP BY [PAY].[TaxTable].[TaxType]

records.question: مجموع مقدار محاسبه برای هر پرسنل در سال جاری چقدر است؟
records.reference_sql: SELECT p.[PersonnelId], p.[InsuranceNumber], SUM(c.[Value]) AS TotalValue FROM [PAY].[Personnel] AS p JOIN [PAY].[Calculation] AS c ON c.[PersonnelRef] = p.[PersonnelId] WHERE YEAR(c.[Date]) = YEAR(GETDATE()) GROUP BY p.[PersonnelId], p.[InsuranceNumber] ORDER BY TotalValue DESC

records.question: What is the total calculation value for each personnel in the current year?
records.reference_sql: SELECT p.[PersonnelId], p.[InsuranceNumber], SUM(c.[Value]) AS TotalValue FROM [PAY].[Personnel] AS p JOIN [PAY].[Calculation] AS c ON c.[PersonnelRef] = p.[PersonnelId] WHERE YEAR(c.[Date]) = YEAR(GETDATE()) GROUP BY p.[PersonnelId], p.[InsuranceNumber] ORDER BY TotalValue DESC

records.question: لیست 20 پرسنل اول به همراه وضعیت کارمند، نوع قرارداد و تاریخ استخدام را نمایش دهید.
records.reference_sql: SELECT TOP (20) p.PersonnelId, p.EmployeeStatus, c.ContractType, c.EmploymentDate FROM [PAY].[Personnel] AS p INNER JOIN [PAY].[Contract] AS c ON c.PersonnelRef = p.PersonnelId ORDER BY p.PersonnelId

records.question: Show the first 20 personnel with their employee status, contract type, and employment date.
records.reference_sql: SELECT TOP (20) p.PersonnelId, p.EmployeeStatus, c.ContractType, c.EmploymentDate FROM [PAY].[Personnel] AS p INNER JOIN [PAY].[Contract] AS c ON c.PersonnelRef = p.PersonnelId ORDER BY p.PersonnelId

records.question: شناسه پرسنل، وضعیت شغلی و مرجع داده ماهانه هر پرسنل را نشان دهید، 20 رکورد اول را بر اساس شناسه پرسنل مرتب کنید.
records.reference_sql:
SELECT TOP (20) p.[PersonnelId], p.[EmployeeStatus], mdp.[MonthlyDataRef]
FROM [PAY].[Personnel] AS p
INNER JOIN [PAY].[MonthlyDataPersonnel] AS mdp ON mdp.[PersonnelRef] = p.[PersonnelId]
ORDER BY p.[PersonnelId]

records.question: Show the PersonnelId, EmployeeStatus, and MonthlyDataRef for each personnel, listing the first 20 records ordered by PersonnelId.
records.reference_sql:
SELECT TOP (20) p.[PersonnelId], p.[EmployeeStatus], mdp.[MonthlyDataRef]
FROM [PAY].[Personnel] AS p
INNER JOIN [PAY].[MonthlyDataPersonnel] AS mdp ON mdp.[PersonnelRef] = p.[PersonnelId]
ORDER BY p.[PersonnelId]

records.question: در هر سال، تعداد سایت‌های کاری ایجاد شده چقدر است؟
records.reference_sql:
SELECT YEAR([CreationDate]) AS [Year], COUNT(*) AS [WorksiteCount]
FROM [PAY].[Worksite]
GROUP BY YEAR([CreationDate])
ORDER BY [Year]

records.question: How many worksites were created in each year?
records.reference_sql:
SELECT YEAR([CreationDate]) AS [Year], COUNT(*) AS [WorksiteCount]
FROM [PAY].[Worksite]
GROUP BY YEAR([CreationDate])
ORDER BY [Year]

records.question: تعداد کارمندان بر اساس جنسیت چقدر است؟
records.reference_sql: SELECT [Sex], COUNT(*) AS EmployeeCount FROM [PAY].[Personnel] GROUP BY [Sex]

records.question: What is the count of employees for each gender?
records.reference_sql: SELECT [Sex], COUNT(*) AS EmployeeCount FROM [PAY].[Personnel] GROUP BY [Sex]
